test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, PLACE is written as QMZDD, and BEAUTY is written as CDZTUZ. How will MANSION be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

**Logic :**

 
• **Consonants - Immediate next letter according to English alphabetic series is written.**
 
• **Vowels - Immediate previous letter according to English alphabetic series is written.**

So,

 
• PLACE is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04cce71599e578236f7807a37bb556b5d66b1b5341d370e01d82e99d15026042.png] ​

 
• BEAUTY is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99de3f32329e74b3297f89f7caf5d000f90a61b421be2346d7e0eb22e39d16ef.png] ​

Similarly,

 
• MANSION is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/335b57cd77f12f0dc36775192c9d9dfb5a15b682834f47e2212ffe3b4d4c59da.png] ​

Hence, **"****NZOTHNO"** is the correct answer.

90:T
